newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials gain more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials gain more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 50 points in early trading Thursday after government reports on July consumer prices and industrial production showed inflation well under control.
At 9:42 a.m. EDT, the Dow was up 61 points at 7,990. The New York Stock Exchange activated its limits on program trading.
